title: Filtration of a constructible sheaf by extensions by zero of lisse sheaves
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$, and $F\in\Cons(X,\Lambda)$. Let
$S_1,\dots,S_m$ be a stratification adapted to $F$, ordered as in
[det-lem-coefficient-heart-common-stratification] (1), so that $V_k=S_1\cup\dots\cup S_k$ is
open, with open immersions $v_k\colon V_k\hookrightarrow X$, and let $a_k\colon S_k\hookrightarrow X$.
Put $F_k=v_{k!}v_k^*F\subseteq F$. Then
$$
0=F_0\subseteq F_1\subseteq\dots\subseteq F_m=F,\qquad F_k/F_{k-1}\cong a_{k!}(F|_{S_k}),
$$
and each $F|_{S_k}$ is lisse.
Here $V_0=\varnothing$, and lisse means locally free of finite rank for the pro-étale topology. The category $\Cons(X,\Lambda)$ is the category of constructible $\Lambda_X$-modules of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. For a locally closed immersion $a\colon S\hookrightarrow X$, write $a=i\circ u$, where $u\colon S\hookrightarrow\overline S$ is open and $i\colon\overline S\hookrightarrow X$ is closed, and define $a_!=i_*u_!$. The inclusions in the filtration need not be strict.

proof.text: Use [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients] (1) for the coefficient identifications: every inverse-image coefficient ring $g^{-1}\Lambda_X$ along an immersion $g:T\to X$ is the prescribed $\Lambda_T$. By [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian] every open prefix $V_k$ is Noetherian, hence quasi-compact, and by [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated] it is quasi-separated. Every inclusion between them is quasi-compact: an affine inverse image is an open in a Noetherian scheme, hence quasi-compact; its diagonal is an isomorphism, so it is quasi-separated.

source.place: First paragraph: hypotheses for localization and the nested-open theorem.

proof.text: Localization [det-sf-open-closed-sequence-ring-sheaf] (3) makes each counit $\epsilon_k:F_k\to F$ mono. [lem-sfb-open-filtration-successor] for $W=V_{k-1}\subseteq V_k=V$ gives $d_k:F_{k-1}\to F_k$ with $\epsilon_kd_k=\epsilon_{k-1}$, hence $d_k$ is mono by cancellation. These maps give the non-strict chain over $F$. Extension from the empty open is zero; the identity-open adjunction is the identity, giving both endpoints.

source.place: First paragraph: monic counits, nesting and endpoints.

proof.text: For $k\ge1$, let $c:S_k\hookrightarrow V_k$ be the closed complement of $V_{k-1}$. The cokernel assertion of [lem-sfb-open-filtration-successor] gives $\operatorname{coker}(d_k)\cong v_{k!}c_*c^*v_k^*F=v_{k!}c_*(F|_{S_k})$, since $a_k=v_kc$ and inverse images compose. By [lem-sfb-image-subobject-of-monomorphism], the counit image subobjects are $[\epsilon_{k-1}]$ and $[\epsilon_k]$. Apply [lem-sfb-subobject-inclusion-cokernel] with $f=\epsilon_{k-1}$, $g=\epsilon_k$, $\alpha=1$, $\phi=d_k$. Its required equation is precisely the counit identity in step 2; thus the quotient of the specified subobjects is this cokernel.

source.place: Second paragraph: localization quotient and comparison with the actual subobject inclusion.

proof.text: For $a_k=v_kc=iu$ with the given closure factorization, [lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence] with $R=\Lambda_X$ gives $v_{k!}c_*\cong i_*u_!=a_{k!}$; step 1 identifies its inverse-image rings $a_k^{-1}\Lambda_X$, $c^{-1}\Lambda_{V_k}$ with the prescribed coefficient rings. Applying this to the restriction in step 3 proves the desired quotient formula.

source.place: Second paragraph: comparison of the two locally closed factorizations.

proof.text: Adaptedness and the finite-constant-local-model characterization in [det-lem-coefficient-heart-closure] make each $F|_{S_k}$ lisse. No step requires a strict inclusion.

source.place: Final sentence: lisseness on the adapted strata.

proof_origin.place: Short assembly of localization, the existing open successor and locally closed coherence, with explicit image-subobject and quotient-representative comparisons.

split_report.summary: Q12 deliberate re-split: retain the Q33 repair and extract the missing generic quotient-representative comparison as a new statement-only node, with its existing sorry-free upstream declaration reported for attachment; add the exact Mathlib image-subobject-of-monomorphism leaf. The counit identity is explicitly matched to the hypotheses of this comparison. Statement, prior searches, route and maintainer metadata are unchanged. Reviewer FIX (Q12 maintainer reader): restored the explicit coefficient-ring identification (steps 1, 4), the composition c^*v_k^*F=F|_{S_k} (step 3) and the bracketed localization/successor citations (step 2) that the base carried.
split_report.blueprint: First paragraph: geometric preparation and actual counit-image chain (steps 1-2); second paragraph: new generic subobject cokernel comparison and existing successor quotient (step 3), then existing mixed-factorization coherence (step 4); final lisseness sentence (step 5). New nodes serve these exact representative identifications, rather than restating a filtration clause.

tool_uses.why: Generic localization for arbitrary ring-sheaf modules supplies exact open extension, adjunction, and the actual counit/unit short exact sequence; the coefficient-heart unit does not prove this ambient theorem.
Generic Noetherian-open fact checks quasi-compactness of the V_k and of the open immersions required for localization.
Generic locally-Noetherian quasi-separatedness verifies the remaining localization hypothesis.
Cartesian coefficient isomorphisms identify the arbitrary-ring localization and coherence functors with the specified E or Qlb module functors.

Generic arbitrary-ring factorization independence supplies the precise v_k! c_* = i_* u_! comparison asserted in this unit, and its normalized pure-open composition; no coefficient-heart node supplies this comparison.

Generic nested-open module theorem supplies a natural nesting map with its actual counit identity and cokernel for arbitrary commutative condensed coefficients. It replaces the long inline argument; no other node in the coefficient-heart unit supplies this theorem.
